download_bill.name: Download bill
download_bill.description: Download a bill PDF for given account ID and bill ID

user.title: Authentication
user.description: Enter your phone number (in +7...) and password

account.title: Select accounts
account.description: Please select which accounts to monitor

2fa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
2fa.description: EIRC requires sign-in verification. Enter the code from the latest email. After a connection error, you can retry the same code while it is valid.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthentication
reauth_confirm.description: The EIRC session is no longer valid or requires sign-in verification. Sign in again; existing meters and their settings will be preserved.

error.invalid_auth: EIRC rejected the sign-in. Check your phone number and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to EIRC or read a valid response. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: EIRC has limited the number of requests. Wait before trying again.
error.session_expired: The verification session has expired. Close setup and start signing in again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.proxy_url_required: HTTP Proxy URL is required when using proxy
error.invalid_code: The code is incorrect or expired. Check the code from the latest email.

abort.2fa_method_not_supported: EIRC requires a verification method this integration does not support. Email verification codes are supported.
abort.2fa_send_failed: Could not send the verification email through EIRC. Try again later.
abort.rate_limited: EIRC has limited the number of requests. Wait and start signing in again.
abort.entry_not_found: The integration entry was not found.
abort.cannot_fetch_accounts: Could not retrieve EIRC accounts. Try again later.

send_readings.title: Choose an account
send_readings.description: Choose an account to enter readings for all its available meters and tariffs. Fresh EIRC readings will be fetched first.

reading_values.title: New readings
reading_values.description: Each tariff shows its previous EIRC reading. Enter new values no smaller than the previous readings. Nothing is sent at this step.

reading_confirm.title: Confirm submission
reading_confirm.description:
Account: {account}.

Check all changes (previous → new):

{readings}

One confirmation sends all listed readings serially. Submission stops on an error without automatic retries.

account_selection.title: Select accounts
account_selection.description: Please select which accounts to monitor

error.invalid_account: Choose an account with available meters belonging to this connection.
error.readings_unavailable: Could not fetch fresh readings for all available meters in this account. Try again later.
error.invalid_readings: Fill in every tariff with a finite number no smaller than its previous reading.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm submission or close the form without sending.
error.proxy_url_required: HTTP Proxy URL is required when using proxy

abort.readings_unavailable: No meters are available for submission. Refresh data and check the account status.
abort.readings_sent: Readings were sent to EIRC. Use Refresh now if you need to fetch the updated data.
abort.readings_rejected: EIRC rejected the request. Check the readings and acceptance conditions in the account portal. No automatic retry was made.
abort.readings_result_unknown: The submission result is unknown. EIRC may have accepted the readings. Check the account portal before submitting again. No automatic retry was made.
abort.cannot_fetch_accounts: Could not retrieve EIRC accounts. Try again later.
abort.reauth_required: Sign in to EIRC again using the reauthentication request in Home Assistant.

refresh_in_progress.message: EIRC data is already being refreshed. Wait for it to finish.

refresh_rate_limited.message: You can refresh again in {seconds} s. This limit is shared by all accounts in this connection.

refresh_failed.message: Could not refresh data. Check the account update status.

connection_error.message: Cannot connect to EIRC. Try refreshing again later.

update_failed.message: Could not refresh data. Check the account update status.

authentication_required.message: The EIRC session is no longer valid. Sign in again in the integration settings.

two_factor_required.message: EIRC requires sign-in verification. Complete reauthentication in the integration settings.
